calls.title: GrowthBook <> Cloud Imperium Games - Intro
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Daniel Wathne, Solutions Engineer Logan Bates) demoed their feature flagging and experimentation platform to Cloud Imperium Games (Martin Le Bas, Jocelyn Menard, Emilien Pierru) to address CIG's pain point of lacking centralized AB testing and personalization—currently relying on an internal badge system without experimentation. Next steps include scheduling separate product-focused and technical integration calls, with Martin advocating internally to convince CTO and other stakeholders.
